name: remote-code-agent
description: A mobile-first PTY for Claude Code and Codex behind Cloudflare Tunnel

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check && npm run build:client:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run check && npm run build:client:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
